Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law · Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

tank noun

armoured military vehicle

also tanks, army tank, toy tank

modern

M-O s.v. tank (military vehicle), citing Egger

currus lōrīcātus, currūs lōrīcātī m.

a tank

Literally an armoured car: lōrīcātī are soldiers in breastplates, “whom they call cataphractī” (Liv. 35.48.3, Lewis & Short s.v. cataphractus).

Other words

  • currus cataphractus, currūs cataphractī m.

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. tank (military vehicle), citing Egger

  • autocurrus armātus, autocurrūs armātī m.

    also used · modern · Traupman 188, 390

See also car.
